bricks.description: MOTION: the subject stands nearly still and blinks once naturally every few seconds with soft unhurried eyelids, posture, head angle and expression completely calm between blinks; the scene does not move.
bricks.when: Any portrait that must not read as a photograph.

bricks.description: MOTION: gentle intermittent wind gusts lift and sway loose fine strands of hair around the face and collar, moving organically before settling, never blown wildly; the face and body stay still.
MOTION: a soft cloud of breath appears with each slow exhale every four seconds and dissolves in the cold air; the subject otherwise holds still.
MOTION: the hem and loose edges of a long coat flutter in a light steady wind, small ripples running along the fabric; the body underneath and the scene stay still.
bricks.when: A lone figure in an open place.
